My father encouraged my interest, even though he didn't have formal education in it. We'd often solve problems together during hikes, making learning fun. Now, as a part-time employee, I still find time to explore new math concepts, especially when hiking alone.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, when faced with complex equations, I feel a bit anxious. My high neuroticism makes it worse. But yoga helps me calm down and approach problems more clearly. I remember a time during my upper secondary education where math seemed overwhelming, but breaking tasks into smaller steps eased the anxiety.
